note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation, held in October after the ordinary day was moved from 15 May to 15 October for 1937; nominations Tuesday 5 October, poll Friday 15 October 1937. Eleven members were declared unopposed at the close of nominations and a twelfth (Falls) after the Labour nominee withdrew; Pottinger, Shankill and St George's were contested (Irish News, 6, 7 and 16 October 1937). The Belfast News-Letter for October 1937 is not in the Irish Newspaper Archives. Returned unopposed.
